title: Scan fold
statement: Given types $A$ and $\Gamma$ and a function $\delta : A \times \Gamma \to A$, define the scan fold to send each pair $(a,\gamma)$ to $(\delta(a,\gamma),\gamma)$; it updates the state using the current symbol and returns that symbol unchanged.
